 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 8 th Of November, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 45822 of 2024
 Dev Singh @ Bhura Yadav
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri S.S. Thakur - Advocate for applicant.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Aman Patel - Panel Lawyer for State.

Order 
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.312/2022 registered at Police Station - Bakshwaha, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 506/34 of IPC and Section 4/5 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 27.03.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he alongwith other co-accused persons kidnapped the minor prosecutrix from her home.
Thereafter, present applicant has committed rape with the prosecutrix.
On the basis of which, the FIR was registered against the applicant and co-accused persons under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in jail since 27.03.2024.
When statements of the prosecutrix under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. were recorded, at that time she has not stated anything against the applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55304 2 MCRC-45822-2024
Later on, in supplementary statements, she has stated against the applicant on the pressure of her parents.
It is further submitted that statements of prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded in which they have not supported the prosecution story.
Father of prosecutrix in para 9 of his statements has deposed that he has not mentioned the date of birth of her daughter, it was written by the Teacher.
There is no criminal antecedents of the applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
It is further submitted that if date of birth of prosecutrix is not correct, applicant may get the benefit of bail.

In this regard he has placed reliance upon the decision of Apex Court in the case of State of Madhya Dev Singh @ Bhura Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110680818/
1 Pradesh Vs. Munna, (2015) 155 AIC 178 and Division Bench judgment of this Court passed in Cr.A.
No.3154/2024 on 06.08.2024.

sentences.text: He has also placed reliance upon the decisions of Apex Court in the case of State of Gujarat Vs. Jayantibhai Somabhai Khant, 2015 Cri LJ 3209 and another decision of Bombay High Court in the case of Suresh Vs. State of Maharashtra passed in Criminal Appeal No.306 of 2016 .

entities.text: State of Gujarat Vs. Jayantibhai Somabhai Khant, 2015 Cri LJ 3209
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicants may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and prayed for its rejection by submitting that age of the prosecutrix is about 15 years and 3 months.
Present applicant has committed rape with minor prosecutrix.
DNA report is also found positive.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and seriousness of offence, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55304 3 MCRC-45822-2024 of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands dismissed.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Sateesh Dev Singh @ Bhura Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110680818/
